content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GGSGH Junior Resident (BDS) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Guru Gobind Singh Govt Hospital (GGSGH) for filling up temporary positions on an ad-hoc basis in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Resident (BDS) under the healthcare department of Guru Gobind Singh Govt Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Junior Resident (BDS) post by the hospital administration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly walk-in. Candidates need to report directly to the designated venue with all required documents on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 09-10-2026 at the designated reporting time and venue in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BDS degree along with a valid registration from the Dental Council and must have completed their internship on or after 09.10.2024.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Resident (BDS) post is 30 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written test for eligible registered candidates, shortlisting of candidates numbering approximately 5 times the vacancies, followed by a final interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at the Establishment Branch B block 3rd floor, Guru Gobind Singh Govt. Hospital, Raghubir Nagar, New Delhi-110027.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview for these posts.
